name: github
description: Connects GitHub's official remote MCP server (api.githubcopilot.com). Two servers: a read-only one for repositories, issues, pull requests and Actions, and a read-write one you add only when you want the agent to open issues, comment or edit. Authenticates with a fine-grained personal access token you provide.

github_token.title: GitHub personal access token
github_token.description: A fine-grained token scoped to the repositories the agent may see. Read-only scopes are enough for the read-only server.
